name: Ego-OSCAR-550h (Stereo-550)
tagline: 550 h of calibrated 720p stereo video with IMU from an open-hardware head rig, captioned end to end with 209k free-form action segments.

annotations.coverageNote: 209,315 free-form captions cover ~100% of the 550 h timeline; per-session stereo calibration on every session; IMU on 86.9% of sessions.

narrations.note: Open-vocabulary free-form captions, median 94 segments per session

action_labels.note: Timestamped segments (start_time, end_time, text); 460 verbs, 32,630 object phrases

object_boxes.note: Paper reports per-frame hand detections (94%); not in the card's file list

hand_pose.note: No hand pose shipped; license carves out possible WiLoR/MANO layers

camera_pose.note: Not released; paper reports visual-odometry convergence only

depth.note: Calibrated 42 mm stereo pair at 1280x720; no depth maps shipped
